authority: The Studio journal and exact accepted local artifacts remain authoritative; remote tracking is a redacted counterpart and never supplies approval.

checkpoints.record: Record the readiness identity, exact evidence digests, approved instance envelopes, and authorized first-milestone boundary.
Record task ID, work package, owner instance, dependencies, isolated workspace, and local-to-GitHub counterpart or retry marker.
Record claimed/running state, attempt number, lease, exact workspace, and current candidate base.
Record blocker evidence or exact resolution evidence and preserve a safe-resume marker before continuing.
Record exact candidate digest, changed locators, tests, residual risks, and the ordered assurance chain.
Record reviewer identity, independence, exact candidate binding, outcome, findings, and Orchestrator-routed remediation.
Record only the application's owner's explicit decision bound to the exact milestone-review digest.

failure_rule: A remote synchronization failure never rolls back or overwrites local Studio state; it creates an actionable retry marker and blocks only the remote-dependent action.
scope_limit: Only service-booking-2-foundation is tracked by this readiness plan. Later milestone tasks remain planned and unauthorized.
